signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Pro, balancing customer needs, business opportunity, and platform investment.
Build a deep understanding of portfolio operators and HOAs: how they assess providers, bring properties and teams onto a platform, manage their operations, and decide whether to…
Improve the end-to-end experience—from evaluating and adopting Pro through onboarding, ongoing portfolio management, and renewal or expansion.
Identify shared needs across customer types and shape modular, configurable product capabilities that avoid one-off development for each use case.
Make clear product choices across a large, ambiguous surface area, sequencing work and explaining tradeoffs to senior stakeholders and delivery teams.
Own the product roadmap from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing, with activation rate, time to live and 180-day retained activations as the measures of success
Find where owners stall — property setup, photo scheduling, permits, rates, multi-property onboarding — and decide what to fix first and how
